title: Network probe library and customer readiness report for Private/VPC onboards
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Problem: Enterprise customers bringing Redwood Private deployments (VPC and on-prem) repeatedly fail basic network and upgrade prechecks. Current intake relies on free-form network docs and ad-hoc human validation which increases time-to-onboard and engineering hours. Goal: ship a lightweight, extensible network probe library plus a one-click customer-facing readiness report that summarizes pass/fail checks, remediation steps, and required config snippets. The deliverable should be usable by sales/CS during pre-sales and by platform engineers during onboarding, and should integrate with the existing intake flow and case notes.
scope: In scope: a containerized probe set that runs deterministic checks (DNS, TLS handshake, HTTP fetch, outbound port egress, NTP reachability, KMS endpoint routing), a small Redwood CLI wrapper to run probes and emit JSON, and a templated PDF/HTML readiness report for customers. Out of scope: agent-based continuous monitoring post-onboard and automatic remediation orchestration (future work).
acceptance_criteria: Probe container image that runs 15 canonical checks and exits non-zero on any failed critical checks
CLI command `redwood-probe run --output report.json` that returns a documented JSON schema and exit codes
Auto-generated customer-facing report (HTML + PDF) with clear remediation guidance and copy suitable for CS to send
Integration hook in intake workflow to attach probe output to the Linear ticket and to the customer record in Salesforce
Security review completed for probe image and no sensitive data exfiltration (KMS endpoints tested only, no credentials stored)
